reviews.author: ARCHIE PENDER
reviews.text: Lance is very knowledgeable and professional. His prices are the best and he goes out of his way to help.

reviews.author: Diana Lamm
reviews.text: Lance is awesome! Always lends a helping hand! Awesome mechanic and a good person! Lance will get you right!

reviews.author: Daniel McLean
reviews.text: Lance is a fantastic mechanic. He has always come through for me, and rates are very reasonable. He's extremely honest, which we all know is very rare in a mechanic. You will not be disappointed. Would highly recommend using him for your auto and diesel repair needs.
